policy.challenger: M15/H1 EMA+DMI; H1 ADX>=18; H4/D context not compulsory. Same exhaustion, stop, nearest-target, gross>=1.50/net>=1.35, news and spread gates.
policy.costs: OANDA ask buys/bid sells and opposite exit side; no second spread deduction in realised returns. Slippage, financing and Pepperstone fills unknown.
policy.drawdown: Sum of per-trade net R, not portfolio/account drawdown; overlapping correlated trades not a portfolio model.
policy.timing: Actual study decision times plus 1 minute manual delay, rounded to next M15 opening; no assumed pattern-close fill.
policy.validation: Prospective frozen rules; historical development cohorts separate; no automatic promotion. Insufficient data is not zero expected risk.
